_readme: Admin file: edit one object to change a photo card. Empty string = not filled yet (do not invent numbers). type must be slab|log|veneer|table|epoxy|workshop. lane must be A_placi|B_furnir|C_special. hero_lane A|B = stock heroes, D = portfolio, C|E = About workshop/yard. slab/log/veneer render on /stock; table/epoxy on /portfolio.
